a81335f995a4ee4ddfb7de67cb260705.overview: In 1910, a stage actress re-visits her husband and children she deserted ten years ago.
a81335f995a4ee4ddfb7de67cb260705.tagline: Now He Knew Her as Other Men Had!

a813fb6a03ee8003a85f9671a715bebe.overview: A celebrity model couple are invited on a luxury cruise for the uber-rich, helmed by an unhinged, alcoholic captain. What first appears Instagrammable ends catastrophically, leaving the survivors stranded on a desert island in a struggle of hierarchy.

a819bb6a685be0306e865c899570b186.overview: Grace Quigley is nearing the end of her life, living alone in her New York apartment. On the day she's being evicted, she witnesses a murder being committed by a top hit-man, Seymour Flint. She proposes to blackmail him into killing her, however, she has one or two friends she wants him to get rid of first.
a819bb6a685be0306e865c899570b186.tagline: Grace & Seymour have hit on a new solution to an age old problem

a84acce35f85a429bdffda102d4f89d9.overview: At the American Computer Chess Convention, enthusiasts gather to pit their programs against other computer chess programs and human players in a tournament for a grand prize of $7500.

a886d97aa6953cd74259ab80ee484b4e.overview: Bob Ford murders his best friend Jesse James in order to obtain a pardon that will free him to marry his girlfriend Cynthy. The guilt-stricken Ford soon finds himself greeted with derision and open mockery throughout town. He travels to Colorado to try his hand at prospecting in hopes that marriage with Cynthy is still in the cards.
a886d97aa6953cd74259ab80ee484b4e.tagline: THE THRILLING AND COLORFUL LAST DAYS OF AMERICA'S MOST FABULOUS OUTLAW...POWERFULLY WRITTEN IN GUNSMOKE!

a89031fdb57c926ecab346d738284697.overview: Shin-ae moves to her recently late husband’s hometown. Despite her efforts to settle in this unfamiliar and too-normal place, she finds that she can’t fit in. After a sudden tragedy, Shin-ae turns to Christianity to relieve her pain, but when even this is not permitted, she wages a war against God.

a891817ac543abc5694de42a84454e7d.overview: In a crime-ridden Los Angeles, an anxious young man is put up to a menacing test by his girlfriend on a weekend retreat.

a8a0da66a0bc86655131b32d4b20c24c.overview: Given a pardon from jail, Roy Earle gets back into the swing of things as he robs a swanky resort.
a8a0da66a0bc86655131b32d4b20c24c.tagline: HE KILLED... and there on the crest of Sierra's highest crag... HE MUST BE KILLED!

a8bda68dc98c609a4a2b2bc5251e5f93.overview: A history professor and his wife entertain a young couple who are new to the university's faculty. As the drinks flow, secrets come to light, and the middle-aged couple unload onto their guests the full force of the bitterness, dysfunction, and animosity that defines their marriage.
a8bda68dc98c609a4a2b2bc5251e5f93.tagline: You are cordially invited to George and Martha's for an evening of fun and games

a8c8612382c6fcb45a47b3086cb12601.overview: A fisherman and a rising lawyer who grew up together as brothers fall in love with the same woman.
